title: Power platform developer
description:
POSITION TITLE: Microsoft Power Platform Developer (individual contractor 6 – 12-month term with the possibility of extension, remote in Brazil)
JOB OVERVIEW:
Working with our IT team to develop Power Platform solutions and provide technical support for the Power Platform systems. We are seeking a skilled Microsoft Power Apps Developer to join our dynamic IT team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, implementing, and supporting business applications using Microsoft Power Apps and Power Automate. This role requires a deep understanding of Power Platform, business process approval workflow, to create efficient and scalable solutions that meet our business needs.
JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:
• Design, develop and maintain Power Platform Applications (specifically Dynamics) and related components (e.g., Power Apps, Power Automate).
• Experience writing and maintaining Power Platform flows for automation and system efficiency.
• Build APIs and integrations to connect external systems and implement business logic and flows.
• Integrate Power Platform with other Microsoft services including Power BI, and Share Point.
• Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
• Create and maintain documentation for developed applications and processes.
• Provide technical support and troubleshooting for Power Platform solutions.
• Conduct training sessions and workshops for end-users to ensure effective utilization of developed applications.
• Working remotely cover 4 hours of US Pacific time zone (between 9:00am – 5:00pm PST).
JOB QUALIFICATIONS:
• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.
• Proven experience in developing applications using Microsoft Power Platform.
• Strong knowledge of Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI and API.
• Experience with Microsoft Share Point, Microsoft Dynamics, and other Microsoft services.
• Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
• Strong communication and collaboration skills in English.
• Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
• Microsoft Power Platform certification is preferred.
WORK LOCATION:
Remote in Brazil

title: College-level chemistry tutor
description:
We are looking for tutors to solve college-level Chemistry questions in English. These questions are submitted by students, who expect a response in less than 24 hours.
Tutors in this project work in freelance mode and can decide the number of hours they wish to work.
Do you prefer to work in the morning, in the evening, for a few hours or many hours? The choice is yours. You can log in at any time to help students. In addition, you can work from anywhere, as long as you have a computer with a reliable Internet connection.
We need tutors who can start immediately!
Characteristics
Payment in dollars.
Type of contract: freelance/self-employed.
Schedule: Flexible, free choice
Start: Immediate
Duration: Indefinite
Requirements

Ability to solve university-level questions in at least one of the following subjects:
General Chemistry
Organic Chemistry
Student or graduate of a university course whose curriculum includes at least one of the subjects listed in the previous point.
Computer with an Internet connection.
No criminal record.
About Latin Hire
Founded in 2003, Latin Hire is a company specialising in managing teams of experts for distance learning institutions. Its clients include some of the world's most prestigious education startups.

title: Brazil packaging salesperson, remote
description:
We are a leading cosmetic packaging company. Our product offerings support beauty, personal care, and cosmetic brands with high-quality, compliant, and market-ready packaging.
Role Description
We are seeking an experienced Brazilian Cosmetic Packaging Salesperson to join our sales team. This is a full-time remote position reporting to our Sales Manager. The ideal candidate will have proven experience selling cosmetic and personal care packaging products into Brazilian markets, with a strong understanding of Brazilian business practices, regulations, and cultural nuances.
Compensation: $65,000 to $135,000 per year, depending on experience.
Responsibilities
The successful candidate will be responsible for:
- Developing and maintaining relationships with Brazilian cosmetic and personal care brands
- Identifying and pursuing new sales opportunities within Brazil's cosmetic packaging market
- Presenting cosmetic packaging solutions tailored to brand, regulatory, and consumer requirements
- Managing sales pipelines, forecasting, and reporting
- Collaborating with product development, compliance, and logistics teams to ensure customer satisfaction
- Meeting and exceeding sales targets
- Staying informed on market trends, regulations, and competitor activity in Brazilian cosmetic packaging markets
Qualifications
- Proven track record of successful B2 B sales in cosmetic packaging or closely related packaging industries
- Extensive experience working with Brazilian cosmetic, beauty, or personal care markets and customers
- Strong knowledge of Brazilian cosmetic packaging regulations, standards, and labeling requirements
- Fluent in English and Portuguese
- Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills
- Ability to travel to Brazil as needed (20-30% of the time)
- Bachelor's degree in Business, Sales, or a related field
- Proficiency with CRM systems and sales tools
- Salesforce experience is a plus

title: Account manager
description:
LOVE startups and always dreamed of working in tech?
WANT to become a disrupter, tackling one of the world’s biggest problems?
BELIEVE you can use your skills to help change the world?
Oneday is a VC-backed Ed Tech company that supports aspiring entrepreneurs from all corners of society to launch their dream business, with expert support from a mentor, a deep curriculum of content, and a vibrant community of business founders.
We have raised $20 M+ in funding from the UK's and Silicon Valley's leading VCs. Our launch phase has been extremely successful and we have reached a stage to take the next step in driving further awareness and intent for our growing range of products.
We’re looking for Account Managers to join our inbound sales team and own the early-stage founder experience.
What you’ll do..
As an Account Manager, you’ll be responsible for managing warm inbound leads from start to finish:
Conduct high-quality discovery calls with founders who’ve already shown interest
Understand what they’re building, why it matters, and where they’re stuck
Clearly position Oneday’s programs and mentorship
Confidently handle objections and guide qualified founders to the next step
Book next-step calls and keep your pipeline clean and updated
Work in a high-volume environment (150–250 calls/day) while staying sharp
Track your performance and continuously improve conversion rates
This is not a passive customer success role.
It’s a performance-driven, ownership-heavy sales role where outcomes matter.
You’ll likely do well here if you:
Have experience in sales, account management, or customer-facing roles (startup experience is a big plus)
Are comfortable on the phone and can build rapport quickly
Think in terms of numbers, conversion rates, and improvement
Can stay organised and disciplined in a fast-moving environment
Take feedback well and apply it
Have strong written and spoken English skills
Are resilient, proactive, and take ownership of results
What you’ll get:
Unparalleled experience of working for a hyper-growth startup
Having fun and learning from your more experienced colleagues — serial entrepreneurs, investors and engineers
Fully remote working environment
Fantastic opportunity to get to know hundreds of founders and executives in the world on a first name basis

title: Especialista de suprimentos
description:
Descrição da Empresa Harsco Environmental é líder global em serviços ambientais e soluções inovadoras para a indústria do aço, com mais de 130 operações ao redor do mundo. Estamos comprometidos em evoluir continuamente para atender tanto às necessidades de nossos clientes quanto dos nossos colaboradores. Priorizamos ambientes de trabalho seguros e sustentáveis, promovendo altos padrões de qualidade. Onde outros enxergam resíduos, vemos valor inexplorado e oportunidades para um futuro sustentável. Descrição do Cargo Estamos procurando um Especialista em Compras para atuar em nossa unidade localizada no Rio de Janeiro, RJ. Este cargo envolve atividades como emissão e acompanhamento de pedidos de compras, análise e avaliação de fornecedores, negociações contratuais e monitoramento de processos de aquisição. O papel exige atenção a detalhes e capacidade analítica para garantir a eficiência dos processos. Este é um cargo de tempo integral e com necessidade de trabalho presencial. Qualificações Gestão de Pedidos: Experiência em elaboração e acompanhamento de pedidos de compras. Avaliação de Fornecedores e Negociação: Conhecimento em avaliação de fornecedores e negociações contratuais para alinhar custo-benefício e qualidade. Procurement e Análise: Habilidade na gestão de processos de compras e aplicação de habilidades analíticas para tomadas de decisão. Conhecimento de sistemas ERP e proficiência em inglês serão considerados um plus.
Desenvolvimento e homologação de novos fornecedores.
Gestão de contratos nacionais e corporativos (elaboração de minutas, definição de cláusulas, condução de processos de negociação/bid, acompanhamento mensal de prazos, fórmula paramétrica, SLA, renovações e rescisões).
Emissão de BPA (Blanket Purchase Agreement).
Emissão de CPA (Contract Purchase Agreement).
Condução de compras de CAPEX estratégicos.
Apoio na criação, análise e desenvolvimento de KPI’s.
Gestão e controle de documentação.
Acompanhamento de incidentes relacionados a pagamentos, aplicação de penalidades e apuração de responsabilidades.
Realização de análises de inteligência de mercado (redução de custos, inovação de produtos e serviços).
Relacionamento e negociação com fornecedores, clientes internos e externos.
Preparar, orientar e treinar a equipe de compras.
Cumprimento de metas de custo, produtividade, precisão e pontualidade.
Manutenção de métricas e análise de dados para avaliação de desempenho e implementação de melhorias.
Elaboração e análise de relatórios.
Atendimento às leis, regulamentos, normas de compliance, requisitos de qualidade e EHS.
Experiência de pelo menos 5 anos em áreas relacionadas à cadeia de suprimentos
Formação em Administração, Engenharia ou áreas afins.
Inglês Fluente

title: Vendedor | intermitente
description: A loja é ritmo, decisão e equipe.É onde as coisas acontecem, onde se vive a moda e onde cada pessoa contribui. Aqui, seu papel é muito mais do que atender. Você observa, da ideias, cuida do produto e do espaço. Você está lá para os clientes que entram e também para a equipe que trabalha com você. Você fará parte de uma equipe curiosa e criativa, que busca fazer as coisas à sua maneira e se move com entusiasmo até conseguir. Procuramos pessoas que gostem do ritmo, da moda e que transformem o dia a dia a partir do que são. Oferecemos um salário competitivo. Treinamento desde o primeiro dia e oportunidades reais de crescimento. Aqui você encontrará o espaço e a equipe para continuar crescendo com sua própria visão. Oferecemos um ambiente onde aprender faz parte do dia a dia e onde há espaço para contribuir, errar e evoluir. Este pode ser o início da sua história conosco. Caso busque por flexibilidade de horário e/ou busque uma posição de porta de entrada freelance, essa vaga é para você! Nosso contrato de trabalho intermitente, funciona da seguinte forma: O contrato é CLT por tempo indeterminado, atuando em loja sempre que houver uma convocação. Convocação: Duram um período de 15 dias, havendo a possibilidade de renovação por mais 15 dias, que funciona de forma intermitente, de acordo com a necessidade da loja. Renovação: Ocorrem a cada 15 dias. Responsabilidades e atribuições: Atendimento ao cliente; Organização de produtos e loja; Atendimento no provador. Caso você venha fazer parte do nosso time, terá direito à: Salário fixo hora, comissão, vale Transporte, vale refeição, férias e 13o salário proporcionais. Tem interesse em conhecer mais sobre esse modelo de contratação? Faça seu cadastro e traga sua energia para o nosso time!

title: Líder de logística e planejamento de demanda
description:
A So Energy é um fornecedor global de Energy as a Service , garantindo soluções personalizadas para uma ampla gama de organizações e indústrias em todo o mundo.
Estamos com uma oportunidade para: Líder de Logística e Planejamento de Demanda – Rio de Janeiro (RJ)
Breve resumo da posição:
Esta posição tem papel estratégico na liderança das operações logísticas e do planejamento de demanda, sendo responsável por transformar a área de logística de um modelo transacional para um modelo estratégico. Atuará na definição e implementação da estratégia logística, otimização de fluxos inbound e outbound, gestão de fornecedores críticos e integração com áreas-chave do negócio, garantindo eficiência operacional, competitividade de custos e suporte ao crescimento da empresa.
O que buscamos (requisitos necessários)?
Formação superior em Engenharia, Administração ou áreas correlatas;
Vivência sólida em logística em empresas multinacionais;
Atuação prévia em posição de liderança na área de logística;
Forte conhecimento em logística inbound e outbound, comércio exterior e fluxos industriais de produção;
Experiência com sistemas ERP, como SAP e/ou Totvs;
Vivência tanto no lado cliente quanto fornecedor em operações logísticas (ex.: portos, freight forwarders – exceto despachante aduaneiro);
Inglês em nível avançado.
Quais serão suas responsabilidades?
Desenvolver e implementar a estratégia de logística e supervisionar as atividades de todas as equipes logísticas.
Construir operações de transporte confiáveis e competitivas em custos.
Gerenciar contratos e entregáveis de Freight Forwarders, Despachantes Aduaneiros e demais fornecedores da cadeia de transporte.
Definir e implementar a estratégia e os KPIs para mobilização e desmobilização de equipamentos.
Desenhar e implementar as tecnologias e os sistemas de informação logística da empresa, visando aumentar eficiência, rentabilidade, crescimento e nível de serviço ao cliente.
Identificar e solucionar ineficiências de rotas.
Implementar o processo de planejamento de demanda para atender às previsões de vendas.
Monitorar e controlar os níveis de estoque.
Assegurar conformidade com as regulamentações de transporte e comércio internacional.
Desenvolver, implementar e acompanhar KPIs de logística, contribuindo para iniciativas de melhoria contínua nos processos logísticos.
Conduzir e liderar projetos de melhoria contínua.
Elaborar Mapas de Fluxo de Valor (Value Stream Maps) e coordenar iniciativas Kaizen.
Transformar o departamento de Logística de transacional para tático e, posteriormente, de tático para estratégico.
Colaborar com as equipes de compras, manutenção e operações para previsão de demanda e otimização de estoques.
Local de trabalho: Local: Centro - Rio de Janeiro/RJ

title: Advogado - privacidade de dados
description:
Estamos buscando um Advogado com foco em Privacidade de Dados que será responsável por garantir a conformidade da organização com a LGPD e demais normas aplicáveis por meio da orientação jurídica especializada, revisão contratual, desenvolvimento de políticas internas e apoio direto às áreas de negócio. Atuar como agente-chave de governança em privacidade e proteção de dados, promovendo a implementação, manutenção e evolução do sistema de gestão de privacidade, monitorando mudanças regulatórias e fortalecendo a cultura de proteção de dados por meio de treinamentos, consultoria e interação contínua com o DPO e áreas técnicas.
Principais responsabilidades:

Suportar as áreas de negócio com a revisão e negociação de Contratos em relação à LGPD;
Prestar consultoria jurídica interna sobre LGPD, ANPD e ANEEL no contexto de dados pessoais;
Elaborar e revisar políticas, procedimentos e normativos internos relacionados à privacidade e proteção de dados;
Apoiar a implementação e manutenção do sistema de gestão de privacidade e proteção de dados pessoais, bem como dos Programas de Adequação à LGPD das Sociedades do Grupo;
Monitorar alterações regulatórias e avaliar impactos legais no tratamento de dados pessoais e nas atividades das Sociedades do Grupo;
Atuar junto ao DPO e áreas técnicas para garantir conformidade com a LGPD;
Apoiar e promover treinamentos e ações de conscientização o sobre proteção de dados (Legislação, boas práticas e normas internas).
Requisitos:
Ensino superior completo em Direito com registro ativo na OAB;
Atuação ativa na aplicação e condução de processos da LGPD e demais regulamentos da ANPD;
Familiaridade com sistema de gestão de privacidade e proteção de dados pessoais;
Capacidade de interpretar e aplicar normas técnicas e jurídicas em contextos multidisciplinares.
Desejáveis:

Certificações em LGPD, compliance, governança de dados ou segurança da informação são altamente desejáveis.
Experiência prévia em empresas reguladas, preferencialmente do setor elétrico.
Pós-graduação/MBA em Direito Digital ou Proteção de Dados;

title: Software engineer iii
description:
Top 3 habilidades técnicas obrigatórias: Desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful e microsserviços, frameworks Java Script e banco de dados SQL/Postgres
Visão geral da posição
Como Engenheiro(a) de Software Principal na equipe de Administração de Membros dentro das soluções de Arquitetura, Engenharia e Construção da Autodesk, você será responsável por orientar a equipe de engenharia e liderar o design técnico para construir funcionalidades que preparem nossos clientes para o sucesso no Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC).
A equipe de Administração de Membros é responsável por fornecer aos clientes do ACC ferramentas para gerenciar usuários e permissões de hubs e projetos. Trabalhamos diretamente com nossos clientes para oferecer soluções para alguns de seus maiores desafios em gestão de construção. Você desempenhará um papel crítico em transformar essas soluções em realidade.
O ACC melhora a gestão da construção e capacita todos os construtores com equipes conectadas, fluxos de trabalho e dados por meio de uma plataforma onde os usuários podem interagir de forma fluida e eficiente ao longo de todo o ciclo de vida da construção. Nosso objetivo é economizar tempo eliminando redundâncias e oferecendo uma única plataforma que equipes inteiras podem usar para compartilhar informações de forma eficaz. Estamos construindo o futuro do software de construção.
Responsabilidades
Projetar, codificar, testar, depurar e documentar novas e existentes funcionalidades para garantir que a aplicação atenda às necessidades de negócio, qualidade e operação
Construir código robusto e de alta qualidade e estabelecer/manter altos padrões de qualidade e testes
Orientar membros da equipe sobre boas práticas de desenvolvimento de software
Interpretar e traduzir necessidades de negócio em requisitos técnicos e tarefas
Aplicar habilidades de resolução de problemas técnicos para projetar soluções de arquitetura seguras e escaláveis
Pesquisar e impulsionar a adoção de novas tecnologias
Identificar riscos e propor estratégias de mitigação relacionadas à arquitetura da aplicação
Participar ativamente de revisões de código e pull requests
Colaborar com diversas equipes dentro da ACS, tanto locais quanto internacionais
Atender, em regime de rodízio, incidentes críticos fora do horário comercial ou nos fins de semana para garantir disponibilidade 24/7 da plataforma
Qualificações mínimas
Mais de 8 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software e tecnologias web
Mais de 5 anos de experiência em produção com aplicações em infraestrutura de nuvem em larga escala
Experiência avançada na construção de APIs RESTful, microsserviços e interfaces front-end
Experiência avançada com frameworks Java Script (Node.js, React)
Experiência avançada com SQL/Postgres
Forte conhecimento em AWS e arquiteturas em nuvem
Experiência sólida com ferramentas de manutenção e monitoramento de aplicações
Experiência sólida na criação de automações e pipelines de CI/CD
Experiência liderando uma equipe de pelo menos 3 engenheiros de software
Familiaridade com Docker para criação de aplicações containerizadas
Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e capacidade de se comunicar com diferentes públicos, incluindo gerentes de produto, clientes e engenheiros de software
Curiosidade para entender e analisar problemas, pensar criticamente e propor soluções
Habilidade de colaboração remota em equipes distribuídas
Flexibilidade diante de mudanças e capacidade de gerenciar múltiplos projetos
Paixão por crescimento, aprendizado e mentoria
Software de gestão de construção que serve como sua única fonte de verdade para cada projeto.
Saiba como o Autodesk Construction Cloud pode ajudar suas equipes a colaborar com segurança e rapidez em todas as fases do projeto, permitindo entregas dentro do prazo e do orçamento.

title: Systems administrator, senior
description: Newfold Digital empowers the world's business owners, content publishers, and those with ideas to control their online destiny with power and confidence. We enable everyone to be able to establish their online presence. title: Risk management officer
description:
About Us
Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.
Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.
As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.
Key Responsibilities:
Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.
Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including;
Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral
Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels
Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons and counterparty exposures
Ensuring compliance with client/institutional limits and capital requirements
Net-worth monitoring;
Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.
Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.
Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.
Deep practical knowledge in CMN Res. 4557/17 regarding the risk management structure, the financial structure and the information disclosure policy management.
Requirements:
Legally resident in Brazil.
Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function. Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements. Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.
Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.
Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in Portuguese and English . Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors , including: not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
unblemished reputation;
knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.
not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

• Proficiente em falar, ler e escrever em inglês.

title: Landholder and reforestation delivery manager
description:
About Nature Co
Nature Co delivers nature-based solutions (Nb S) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. Nature Co has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.
Nature Co is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.
We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. Nature Co is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.
 
Role and responsibilities
The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for Nature Co’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.
The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.
Primary roles and responsibilities include:
Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management
Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation. Eligibility, due diligence & agreements
Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).
Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
Lead closure of contract signatures.
Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within Nature Co’s data management system (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).
Reforestation delivery enablement
Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).
Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.
Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).
Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress). Stakeholder engagement and safeguards
Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with Nature Co policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).
Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the Nature Co grievance mechanism.
Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.
Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required. Reporting
Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.
Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. Teamwork and culture
Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.
Stay current on emerging best practices in Nb S and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.
Skills and attributes
To perform successfully in this role, you will have:
A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.
Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.
Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.
Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.
A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.
A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners
Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.
A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.
Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.
Location Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia
Submission instructions
Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: Technical product owner
description:
ABOUT US
Syniti , part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.
Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy.
Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.
Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful Saa S solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.
THE ROLE
We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4 HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance.

What You’ll Do
Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions.
Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios.
UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP.
Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value.
Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior.
Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.
WHAT IT TAKES
The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure).
The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus.
The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication.
The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams.
The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience.
The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.
Key Skills Visionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals. Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules. AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic. Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment. Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity. Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement.
Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment.
Be fully aligned with our core values:
Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.
Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.
Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.
Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.
By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process.
WHAT WE OFFER
Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing.
Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.
Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.
Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all.
Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.
An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued.
OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION
At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team.
We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

title: Cloud operations engineer
description:
About Eightpoint
Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our growing ecosystem includes innovative products like Weather Now, a sleek app that delivers real-time forecasts with clarity and ranks among the top three most-used weather apps in the U. S.; Check Heart Rate Now, a quick and easy wellness monitor; and Wave Browser, a powerful and secure way to search the web. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.
About the Role
The Cloud Operations Engineer will provide hands-on operational support across Eightpoint's multi-cloud infrastructure spanning AWS and GCP. This role focuses on maintaining reliability, supporting CI/CD pipelines, and ensuring observability across all environments while enabling the Dev Ops team to focus on project-driven initiatives. The position reports to the Director of IT & Cybersecurity and works closely with the Dev Ops and Systems Administration teams.
Key Responsibilities

Administer and support AWS infrastructure including EKS clusters, Elastic Beanstalk environments, EC2, S3, Cloud Front, RDS, and IAM across a multi-account environment
Support GCP workloads, primarily Big Query pipelines and related data infrastructure.
Maintain and troubleshoot self-hosted applications including Airflow, Grafana, and other internal tooling.
Support and maintain CI/CD pipelines in Git Hub Actions, including self-hosted runners.
Participate in incident response processes — triage, root cause analysis, remediation, and post-incident documentation.
Deploy, configure, and maintain logging, monitoring, and alerting tooling (Grafana stack — Loki, Tempo, Mimir, Alloy; Cloud Watch; One Uptime).
Manage infrastructure-as-code using Terraform.
Participate in on-call rotation providing support across US and offshore time zones.
Contribute to documentation in Confluence and maintain runbooks for operational procedures.
Who You Are

5+ years of experience in a cloud operations, Dev Ops, or infrastructure support role.
Strong working knowledge of AWS core services (EKS, Elastic Beanstalk, EC2, S3, IAM, VPC, RDS, Cloud Front).
Hands-on experience administering containerized workloads (Kubernetes/EKS, Docker).
Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines in Git Hub Actions.
Demonstrated experience with incident response workflows — detection, escalation, remediation, and RCA.
Experience deploying and maintaining observability tooling (logging, metrics, tracing, alerting).
Proficiency in Linux administration and shell scripting (Bash, Python).
Strong experience with Terraform for infrastructure-as-code.
Experience with Atlassian tooling (Jira, JSM, Confluence).
Preferred Qualifications

Experience with GCP, specifically Big Query and related data services.
Experience with Grafana OSS stack (Loki, Tempo, Mimir, Alloy/Faro).
Experience supporting Airflow or similar orchestration platforms.
AWS certifications (Solutions Architect Associate, Sys Ops, or Dev Ops Engineer).
Experience working in multi-account AWS environments with consolidated billing/cost allocation tagging.
Exposure to ZTNA/VPN solutions (Firezone, Twingate, or similar).

title: Sap basis upgrades sum and conversion specialist
description:

Lead SAP S/4 HANA system conversions from ECC, including pre-checks, simplification item analysis, and custom code remediation. title: English teacher with advanced portuguese skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!
Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good Wi Fi, a webcam, and a microphone.
If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!
Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.
What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at Latin Hire?
You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.
If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.
When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!
In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire:

Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
You be your own boss and set your own schedule
Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.
Minimum Requirements:

Portuguese as a first language.
C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
University degree in English Teaching or related area.
One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection.
Must pass a criminal background check.
Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.
Who we are:
Established in 2003, Latin Hire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Immigration paralegal (portuguese speaker)
description:
Company Description
Brooks Law Firm is a trusted legal practice dedicated to serving clients in immigration, personal injury, social security disability, and workers' compensation. We are proudly committed to supporting Spanish-speaking and Brazilian Portuguese-speaking communities, and we work closely with organizations such as the Brazilian Workers Center. Our team provides expert legal guidance across a wide range of matters — including family-based green cards, deportation defense, personal injury claims, and workers' compensation — with a strong emphasis on client satisfaction, clear communication, and personalized service in multiple languages.
Role Description
We are seeking a detail-oriented and organized Family-Based Immigration Paralegal to join our team remotely. In this role, you will work closely with our attorneys to prepare and manage family-based immigration cases from start to finish. The ideal candidate is proactive, client-focused, and thrives in a fast-paced legal environment.
Key Responsibilities
Prepare and file family-based immigration petitions and applications, including forms I-130, I-485, I-765, I-131, and all related supporting documents
Collect, review, and organize client documentation to ensure completeness and accuracy
Maintain and manage case files, deadlines, and follow-ups
Communicate with clients to provide case updates, request documents, and respond to general inquiries
Assist in preparing clients for USCIS interviews, including document review and guidance
Draft cover letters, affidavits, and other supporting materials
Monitor case progress and assist in responding to Requests for Evidence (RFEs)
Coordinate with attorneys to ensure timely filings and full compliance with immigration regulations
Handle all client information with the utmost confidentiality and professionalism
Qualifications
Prior experience in immigration law, specifically in family-based cases
Strong working knowledge of USCIS forms and procedures
Excellent organizational and time-management skills
Strong written and verbal communication abilities
Ability to manage multiple cases simultaneously in a fast-paced environment
Bilingual in English and Portuguese is required — Portuguese speakers only ﻿
To Apply To be considered for this position, all applications must be submitted by email to . Please include your resume and a brief description of your relevant experience.

title: Engenheiro de dados sênior
description:
Sobre a Volpi
Somos uma fintech em crescimento acelerado que está protagonizando a evolução do financiamento imobiliário . Transformamos processos tradicionalmente burocráticos, caros e ineficientes em experiências inteligentes, simples e digitais . Se você acredita que tecnologia pode mudar a vida das pessoas - e quer fazer parte de uma equipe que vive isso na prática - vem com a gente!
O desafio
Buscamos um Senior Data Engineer para liderar a construção da engenharia de dados da Volpi desde a base.
Hoje, nossos dados estão distribuídos em múltiplas fontes, com diferentes níveis de maturidade. Seu papel será estruturar essa fundação: definir a arquitetura, organizar os dados, criar pipelines confiáveis e habilitar a criação de produtos de dados que apoiem decisões críticas de negócio.
Aqui, você terá alto nível de autonomia e ownership , tomando decisões técnicas que vão sustentar o crescimento da empresa nos próximos anos.
O que você vai fazer: Desenhar, implementar e evoluir a arquitetura de dados da Volpi , com foco em um modelo de lakehouse na AWS; Estruturar pipelines de ingestão, transformação e consumo de dados (batch e, futuramente, streaming);
Trabalhar com dados sensíveis de crédito e pessoas, seguindo padrões rigorosos de segurança, governança e compliance ; Lidar com dados distribuídos em múltiplos silos , conectando fontes e criando visões mais maduras para o negócio; Atender demandas estratégicas de diferentes áreas (crédito, operações, produto, engenharia);
Organizar e evoluir o data lake existente (já temos estrutura inicial em AWS, Athena e S3);
Criar a base para produtos de dados futuros , incluindo análises avançadas de crédito e soluções orientadas a dados; Atuar de forma full-cycle, da concepção técnica à implementação, operação e evolução em produção.
O que esperamos de você: Experiência sólida como Data Engineer , com forte mentalidade de engenharia (Data Engineer aqui é dev); Domínio de Python e SQL para construção de pipelines e soluções de dados em produção; Experiência prática com AWS , especialmente serviços como S3, Athena e IAM; Conhecimento e uso de Infraestrutura como Código (Ia C) ; Vivência com pipelines de dados em produção, lidando com volumes relevantes e dados sensíveis;
Forte preocupação com segurança da informação , padrões de projeto e boas práticas de engenharia; Experiência em ambientes de startup , lidando com pouco legado e muita construção do zero; Autonomia para tomar decisões técnicas e conduzir projetos end-to-end;
Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções de dados escaláveis;
Comunicação clara e estruturada, especialmente em ambientes assíncronos.
Será considerado um diferencial:
Experiência com arquiteturas de dados modernas, como lakehouse;
Uso de ferramentas de orquestração e transformação de dados (ex: Airflow, dbt ou similares);
Atuação em domínios complexos e regulados, como financeiro, crédito ou seguros;
Vivência na construção e estruturação de plataformas ou áreas de dados desde o início.
Benefícios que oferecemos:
Modelo remoto prioritário
Plano de saúde Alice (100% pago para titular e dependentes)
R$600/ano para infraestrutura de home office
R$1.000/ano de auxílio educação
30 dias de descanso remunerado + 10 dias de recesso de fim de ano
Day off no aniversário
Total Pass (incluindo Total Mind)
Acesso ao Wework
Encontros presenciais para troca e conexão com a nossa Tribo

title: Coordenador de operações
description:
Sobre a Empresa

Estamos buscando um Coordenador de Operação & Manutenção (O& M) com vivência sólida em usinas termoelétricas com motores a combustão, capaz de atuar desde a fase de implantação/construção, apoiando engenharia e obra com a visão de operação, até a entrada em operação comercial e a rotina de O& M.

Supervisionar testes de desempenho e validações pré-operação, assegurando aderência a requisitos técnicos e normativos.
Coordenar interface com fornecedores e empreiteiras, acompanhando cronograma, qualidade e marcos de entrega.

Apoiar a estruturação da operação: rotinas, indicadores, planos de manutenção, gestão de falhas e confiabilidade.
Qualificações
Formação em Engenharia Elétrica (ou correlatas).
Habilidades Necessárias

Experiência comprovada em O& M e comissionamento em geração de energia em termelétrica.
Forte capacidade de coordenação técnica, liderança e interface com múltiplos stakeholders.
Perfil “mão na massa”, com presença em campo e foco em entrega.
Habilidades Preferenciais

Experiência em implantação / greenfield, comissionamento e start-up de usinas.
Especialização / MBA em Gestão de Projetos.
Inglês técnico / avançado.
Faixa Salarial e Pacote de Compensação

Remuneração compatível com o mercado + benefícios (a definir conforme modelo de contratação).

Declaração de Igualdade de Oportunidades

Projeto relevante, com alto nível de responsabilidade e visibilidade. Ambiente dinâmico, com espaço real para construir processos e formar time.

title: Lead retention strategist

title: Ugc content creator
description:
Location: Remote
Type: Freelance / Contract
Compensation: R$350 – R$450 per week (based on tier) + bonuses (based on views)
Probation period: 2 weeks, paid R$250 / week
About Pure
Pure is a bold, global dating app redefining how people connect. We believe dating should be honest, fun, and free of judgment, a space to explore confidence, chemistry, and self-expression.
We’re building a UGC Creator Community of voices to help tell that story.
About the UGC Creator Community 
We’re looking for social media creators to join our UGC Pure Dating App Creator Community - a group of UGC content creators producing short-form videos (Tik Tok / Instagram) around themes like dating, confidence, self-love, etc.
As a creator, you’ll have the chance to collaborate with our team, build your personal brand, and get paid to create authentic, engaging content that challenges the way people see dating.
What You’ll Do
Create and post 7 short-form videos per week (Tik Tok / Instagram Reels / You Tube Shorts, etc)
Develop content inspired by dating, connection, and self-expression
Drive people to the app 
Participate in creative briefs, trend challenges, and campaigns
Receive feedback and coaching to grow your performance
Collaborate with our team on storytelling ideas and social strategies
What We’re Looking For
You must be based in Brazil and be fluent in Portuguese 
Passion for storytelling, social media, and modern culture
Familiarity with Tik Tok trends, Reels formats, and UGC-style videos
Strong on-camera presence and editing skills
Consistency and ability to meet weekly content goals
Open-minded and comfortable creating content about dating and relationships
Payment Structure
Tiered structure paid weekly
Bonuses for views (starting from 100 K+ views)
Bonuses for registrations
Payments are made weekly
Why Join Us
Get paid to create authentic content about dating & self-expression
Access creative guidance, briefs, and a global network of creators
Build your portfolio while collaborating 
Enjoy creative freedom - your tone, your story, your perspective
How to Apply
Send us your cover letter and tell us a bit about yourself, including why you’d like to work with Pure app. 
You’ll be invited to join a group onboarding call and receive a task to create a test submission video. 
After that, you’ll enter a 2-week trial period, and if successful, you’ll be fully onboarded into the program.
Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products. The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2 B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and Saa S sectors. Responsibilities Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design; Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions; Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and Saa S products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance; Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs; Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite; Stay updated on design trends, user behavior patterns in B2 B software, and industry best practices in product design; Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team. Requirements Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams; Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools; Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, Fig Jam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle; Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2 B software; Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers; Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles. Preferred Qualifications6+ years of experience as a Product Designer Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.); Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions; Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers; Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams; Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions. Why Join Us?At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing Saa S and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You'll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

title: Assembly and after-sales support technician
description:
Job Description
Job Title:Assembly and After-Sales Support Technician
Location:Remote position in Brazil with in-person client visits as required
Reports to:Account Manager and CTO
Contract Type:CLTAbout LG Sonic: LG Sonicis a global leader in sustainable water quality management, dedicated to developing cutting-edge technologies that help protect water ecosystems. With operations in over 50 countries, we specialize in advanced solutions for algae control, water quality monitoring, and environmental protection. Our award-winning ultrasonic technology, combined with real-time data monitoring, empowers industries, municipalities, and governments to maintain clean and healthy water bodies while reducing chemical use. At LG Sonic, we foster a dynamic and innovative work environment, driven by a passion for sustainability and technological excellence. Join our team and be part of a mission to create cleaner water for future generations.Position Summary:
The Assembly and After-Sales Support Technician will be responsible for assembling, installing, and maintaining LG Sonic equipment at our clients' sites across various locations in Brazil. In addition to on-site technical duties, the professional will work remotely in an after-sales capacity, providing direct support and maintaining close communication with clients to ensure their needs are met effectively.
Position duties and responsibilities:
Assemble and install LG Sonic equipment at client locations throughout Brazil, ensuring proper setup and functionality.
Perform routine maintenance, troubleshooting, and repairs on installed equipment to guarantee optimal performance.
Travel to client sites as needed to address technical issues and provide on-site support.
Provide remote after-sales support, responding to client inquiries, offering technical guidance, and resolving issues via phone, email, or other communication platforms.
Maintain direct and proactive communication with clients to ensure satisfaction and address their needs effectively.
Document all assembly, maintenance, and support activities, preparing detailed reports for internal records and client follow-ups.
Collaborate with the LG Sonic team to identify opportunities for equipment improvements or upgrades based on client feedback and field observations.
Adhere to safety protocols and company standards during all on-site and remote activities.Qualification and requirements:
Must reside in Brazil and be willing to travel frequently to client sites across the country with flexibility to adapt to varying schedules.
Excellent communication skills in Portuguese and English (written and spoken)for client interactions, technical support, and reporting.
Proven experience in equipment assembly, installation, and maintenance, preferably in a technical or industrial setting.
Strong problem-solving skills
Ability to work independently in the field and remotely, with strong organizational and time-management skills.
Familiarity with remote support tools and basic computer skills for documentation and communication.
Valid driver’s license and ability to operate safely in diverse working environments.
Previous experience in after-sales or customer support roles is a plus.Why Join LG Sonic?At LG Sonic, we offer an exciting and collaborative work environment where your contributions directly impact our mission of environmental sustainability and innovation. By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to grow professionally while being a part of a global leader in water treatment technology. We believe in investing in our people and fostering an inclusive culture where every team member’s ideas are valued.LG Sonic Values : Unity, Trust, Positivism, Over deliver and Passion.Application Process:If you are interested in joining LG Sonic, we encourage you to apply by following these steps:
Submit Your CV: Please send yourupdated CV in Englishtowith the subject line:Assembly and After-Sales Support Technician.
Apply via Recruitment Platforms: You may also apply through recruitment websites where this position is posted. Please ensure yourCV is submitted in English.
Application Review: Our HR team will carefully review all applications and contact shortlisted candidates for the next steps.
Interview Process:Selected candidates will be invited for interviews to assess their skills, experience, and suitability for the role.

 • Stay current on platform updates, policy changes, and best practices

Join to apply for the Embedded Linux Senior Software Engineer - Optimisation role at Canonical

Work across the full Linux stack from kernel through GUI to optimise Ubuntu, the world's most widely used Linux desktop and server, for the latest silicon.

The role is a fast-paced, problem-solving role that's challenging yet very exciting. The right candidate must be resourceful, articulate, and able to deliver on a wide variety of solutions across PC and IoT technologies. Our teams partner with specialist engineers from major silicon companies to integrate next-generation features and performance enhancements for upcoming hardware.

Location: This is a Globally remote role

What your day will look like

  • Design and implement the best Ubuntu integration for the latest IoT and server-class hardware platforms and software stacks
  • Work with partners to deliver a delightful, optimised, first class Ubuntu experience on their platforms
  • Take a holistic approach to the Ubuntu experience on partner platforms with inputs on technical plans, testing strategy, quality metrics
  • Participate as technical lead on complex customer engagements involving complete system architectures from cloud to edge
  • Help our customers integrate their apps, SDKs, build device OS images, optimize applications with Ubuntu Core, Desktop and Server
  • Work with the most advanced operating systems and application technologies available in the enterprise world.

Joining Canonical, you will partner with bright minds from all over the world, and work with an exciting set of new technologies in a fast growing company with a truly unique and ambitious vision to build a better platform with free software. You will work with customers on exciting IoT and server platforms and technologies, built to support different verticals: from robots to data centers, from telco to retail.

What we are looking for in you

  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, STEM or similar
  • You have experience with Linux packaging (Debian, RPM, Yocto)
  • You have experience working with open source communities and licences
  • You have experience working with C, C++
  • You can work in a globally distributed team through self-discipline and self-motivation.

Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring

  • Experience with graphics stacks
  • Good understanding of networking - TCP/IP, DHCP, HTTP/REST
  • Basic understanding of security best practices in IoT or server environments
  • Good communication skills, ideally public speaking experience
  • IoT / Embedded experience – from board and SoC, BMCs, bootloaders and firmware to OS, through apps and services
  • Some experience with Docker/OCI containers/K8s

What we offer you

Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.

In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, you can ask in the later stages of the recruitment process.

  • Fully remote working environment - we've been working remotely since 2004!

  • Recognition rewards

  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at 'sprints'

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.

title: Senior Product Manager - Mode (Remote)
description:
About Mode Mobile

Mode Mobile is the creator of EarnOS, a transformational software that turns ordinary smartphones into "EarnPhones". This innovation empowers users globally to monetize everyday mobile activities such as streaming, gaming, shopping, etc., turning users into earners and, eventually, owners through stock ownership based on usage. The company has facilitated over $150M in earnings and savings for more than 40 million users across 170 countries.

Team & Culture

Our team is the heart of our culture. We value innovation, collaboration, curiosity, and a passion for getting things done. We strive to hire and cultivate the best team members and foster open communication and transparency. Our culture is driven by OKRs, positive intent, ownership, and a commitment to high standards.

For more details on how we work, you can read further at our internal resources.

The Role

Mode Mobile is seeking a Senior Product Manager to lead product strategy and execution for a recently acquired multimillion‑dollar utility app. Over time, the role will expand to encompass newly acquired and organically developed mobile applications. This senior‑level, high‑ownership role requires a proven product leader with business acumen, operational excellence, and user empathy.

Key Responsibilities
  • Define and lead a vision for your products that aligns with organizational goals
  • Develop strategic product‑feature roadmaps and drive execution from concept to scale by analyzing and implementing best‑in‑market trends and out‑of‑the‑box ideas
  • Collaborate with Engineering, Design, User Acquisition, Monetization, and Data teams to deliver value‑driven, measurable results
  • Own business and product performance, including revenue, engagement, conversion, retention, and P&L outcomes, and financial forecasts
  • Conduct ongoing experimentation, user and competitor research to support strategic decision making that drives monetization and user growth
  • Provide visibility into business performance and communicate results clearly to executive stakeholders and the broader organization
  • Serve as a role model and standard‑setter for product excellence for your cross‑function team
Who You Are
  • A strategic, business‑minded product leader with deep understanding of P&L ownership and revenue drivers
  • A self‑starter who thrives in ambiguity and operates with high accountability in driving efficient product pipelines
  • Experienced leading product dev teams to drive engagement and impact on the product and business
  • Expert at balancing user value with business impact, ensuring that both scale together
  • Skilled at using data, A/B experimentation, and intuition to make the best possible decisions
  • A natural collaborator who communicates effectively across all levels of the organization
  • Alignment with our core values
  • Accountable: Take ownership of responsibilities, demonstrate trustworthiness, and consistently follow through on commitments
  • Action‑driven: Identify priorities, agree on scope, execute in a timely manner, and drive the greatest impact
  • Caring: Genuinely care about people, the business, and the mission, and strive to create a positive, supportive environment
  • Curious: Focus on the "why," learn, expand knowledge, explore new ideas, and continually improve
  • Thorough: Deliver thoughtful, accurate, and complete work with meticulous attention to detail
Qualifications
  • 7+ years of professional product management experience, including 3+ years of independently owning a product or business line
  • Proven experience managing products with P&L accountability and delivering measurable business outcomes
  • Experience in mobile app ecosystems, with strong understanding of subscription, IAP, and IAA monetization strategies (utility, rewarded, social, or gaming apps is a plus)
  • Demonstrated success within multi‑app portfolios
  • Strong analytical skills; proficiency in data tools such as Mixpanel, Google Sheets, and business performance dashboards
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, capable of influencing at the executive level
Why This Role Matters

This is a high‑impact role where you will be the ringleader for one of Mode's most successful mobile apps, driving millions of users and ~$10 M / yr in revenue. Your success can help create blueprints for aggressive expansion through in‑house products and M&A, opening opportunities across the portfolio.

Workplace Norms
  • Allow OKRs to guide us
  • Assume positive intent
  • Agree to disagree & commit
  • Set new precedents
  • Accomplish more with less
  • Hold yourself & others to high standards
  • Speak up
  • Be resourceful
  • Follow the 80/20 rule
What We Are Offering
  • 100% remote‑first, global company
  • A competitive compensation package
  • Generous perks & benefits
  • Participation in the company equity and token plan (full‑time)
  • Individual bonuses in accordance with our bonus program
  • Work with energetic, passionate, and results‑driven people
  • Celebrate personal & work milestones
  • Remote social activities, including virtual coffee buddies
  • Recognition via Bonusly
  • Weekly Wednesday "Get Stuff Done Days" (no meetings)
  • Open PTO and generous company holidays
  • 10 annual Wellness Fridays
Next Steps

If we just described the role you want and your ideal team, we'd love to talk with you. We have a lot to accomplish this year and look forward to creating success together!

Equal Employment Opportunity

Mode Mobile does not accept or pay fees for unsolicited resumes from third‑party agencies/vendors. Our company is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer. We are committed to providing a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We celebrate diversity and strive to create an inclusive environment for all team members.

Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, aWLM atua de forma estratégica e integrada nos segmentos automotivo, do agronegócio, de energia e de soluções sustentáveis, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento deconcessionárias Scania , a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operaçõesEquipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) eSupermac(AM e RR).

No segmento doagronegócio , por meio de suas controladasFartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% daCHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce aEkoTruck , uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG.

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (”FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil.
